title: Life of Colors game instance (schema_version 1.x)
description: One puzzle. Produced by the private factory (export_catalog.py / instance.py), played by src/engine/engine.js, referenced by id in telemetry. Only rule, board and goal are hashed into the id; published instances are immutable. Add variations as NEW optional fields plus a feature tag in `requires`; never change the meaning of an existing field.

id.description: 'loc_' + first 16 hex of sha256(canonical JSON of {rule, board, goal}) -- sorted keys, no whitespace.

requires.description: Feature tags the engine must support. Known: core.

neighborhood.description: Up to 8 surrounding cells that lie on the board.

table.description: New colour per (orange, blue, green) neighbour-count triple, o+b+g<=8, ordered o outer, b middle, g inner, ascending. U uncolored, O orange, B blue, G green, X unchanged.

start.description: Cells that do not start uncolored.

special_cells.description: Reserved for future variations (each entry {type, at, ...} with a feature tag). Must be empty for 'core'.

level.description: App level the instance is offered under.

start_cell_required.description: Not hashed, optional. false = the factory's recorded solution also wins from an all-uncolored board; with the app's HIDE_START_CELL_IF_NOT_REQUIRED switch on, such puzzles are shown without their start cell(s). true / null / absent = the start cell is always shown.

moves_to_win_min.description: Not hashed, optional. The lowest number of moves to win the factory found (its tested CSVs' moves_to_win_min; the proven minimum when meta.proven_min_moves is true). The app shows it under the moves counter as 'Best: X' and rates a win with 1-5 stars: 5 at or below it, 2 at 1.4 x it, linear in between (rounded), 1 above. null / absent = unknown: no 'Best' and no stars.

name.description: Not hashed. Verbose puzzle name shown in the app instead of the id, '<colour word> <object word>' from the factory's naming_vocabulary.csv (e.g. 'Crimson Delta'). Assigned once when first published and never changed or reused (factory exports/published_instances.csv). Lookups ignore case, spaces and punctuation.

name_color.description: Not hashed. Colour of the name's colour word (#RRGGBB); the level grid draws the puzzle's tile in it. May be corrected in later exports, the name stays.

seq.description: Not hashed. Publication order (1 = first published); the level grid shows puzzles in this order, so new puzzles appear at the end.

retired.description: Kept so telemetry stays interpretable, but hidden by the app.

meta.description: Analysis metadata (source rule_set_idx, moves_to_win, difficulty_rank, ...). Not hashed, not used by the engine.

ext.description: Experimental attributes. Ignored by the app, not hashed.
